title: Viva Carmen (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
In 1840, in Seville, Salvador, a young assistant to the gifted knife grinder Antonio, meets a captivating gypsy girl named Carmen. Her rapturous beauty and independent spirit are the talk of the town, but Antonio’s ability to glimpse the future foretells a tragic fate. With unwavering resolve, Salvador will muster an eclectic band of misfit kids, led by the spirited Belén, to protect Carmen against her destiny, igniting the ancient city’s alleyways in a symphony of emotions.

 

The film will be introduced by the "Directors' Fortnight's Artistic Director Julien Rejl  on 28 NOVEMBER at PREMIERE ELEMENTS.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
一八四零年的塞維亞，Salvador是才華洋溢的磨刀匠Antonio身邊的年輕助手。他遇見了迷人的吉卜賽少女Carmen，她令人神魂顛倒的美貌與獨立不羈的個性成為全城熱話。然而，Antonio擁有瞥見未來的能力，預示她將迎來悲劇命運。Salvador下定決心，召集一群形形色色的邊緣少年，由活潑勇敢的Belén帶領，合力保護Carmen對抗宿命，在古城的巷弄間交織出一首情感交響曲。

 

11月28日PREMIERE ELEMENTS 場次映將由「導演雙週」藝術總監Julie  Rejl  作開場介紹。
